a: This effect affects 1 of your opponent's Digimon with no digivolution cards, and the processing prevents that Digimon  from attacking or blocking until their turn ends.
Even if it gains a digivolution card after being affected by the effect, the effect will continue processing.
Card Q&A.q: If a Digimon affected by this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect later gains a digivolution card, can it now attack or block?

Effect: [Security] At the end of the battle, play this card without paying the cost.
[On Play] [When Digivolving] Trash the top 2 digivolution cards of 1 of your opponent's Digimon. Then, 1 of their Digimon with no digivolution cards can't attack or block until their turn ends.
Inherited Effect: [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] If you have 7 or fewer cards in your hand, ＜Draw 1＞. (Draw 1 card from your deck.)
